roadmap.title: Normal mode and both endings
roadmap.description: Pause in the nightclub for the music achievement, then enter GOD on the waiver. Use one normal attempt for the third-round death, then replay normal mode and win to unlock Double or Nothing. Try the optional self-shot feats before starting a valuable money streak.

roadmap.title: Short Double or Nothing runs and item combinations
roadmap.description: Open the bathroom leaderboard, then take the pills. Cash out after the first three-round set on one run. On another, accept one double, win the next set and cash out. Build the item combinations on low-stakes attempts and start the mode ten times in total.

roadmap.title: Two million-dollar streaks
roadmap.description: Track every live shell and blank while doubling the displayed balance. First cash out above $1,000,000. On a separate streak, reach that amount again, continue and die to lose the money. Expect retries when shell order or item draws go against you.

achievements.summary: Win the final round against the Dealer in normal mode.

steps.text: Leave the bathroom without taking the pills to play normal mode. Reach round three and defeat the @enemy{Dealer}.

Keep a running count of live shells and blanks, including shells removed by Beer. When a @item{Magnifying Glass} reveals a live shell, use a @item{Hand Saw} before firing at the Dealer for double damage.

achievements.summary: Die during the third round of normal mode.

steps.text: In normal mode, reach round three and let the @enemy{Dealer} kill you, or fire live shells at yourself. If you already won normal mode, replay it without taking the bathroom pills.

achievements.summary: Take the bathroom pills that activate Double or Nothing.

steps.text: After winning normal mode, return to the bathroom and use the @item{pills} beside the TV.

achievements.description: Start the 'Double or Nothing' mode 10 times.
achievements.summary: Begin 10 separate Double or Nothing runs.

steps.text: Use the bathroom pills to start @mechanic{Double or Nothing} ten times in total. To make another start quickly, press R during an attempt to return to the bathroom, then take the pills again.

achievements.description: Cash out immediately in 'Double or Nothing'.
achievements.summary: Take the first cash-out offer in a Double or Nothing run.

steps.text: Win the opening three-round set in @mechanic{Double or Nothing}. Choose @mechanic{X} at the first offer to take the money. If you accept a double instead, try again on a new run.

achievements.description: Double your earnings in 'Double or Nothing' and win.
achievements.summary: Cash out in Double or Nothing after successfully doubling the winnings at least once.

guide.context: The title does not require a $140,000 balance; a successful double followed by cash-out is enough.

steps.text: Win the opening three-round set in @mechanic{Double or Nothing}, then accept the offer to double your winnings.
Win the next three-round set and choose @mechanic{X} to cash out. If you die before banking the money, start another run and try again.

achievements.description: Cash out over 1,000,000 in 'Double or Nothing'.
achievements.summary: Bank more than $1,000,000 from one Double or Nothing run.

guide.context: The first set sets your starting payout; later sets double that amount. A starting payout above $31,250 reaches the target after five doubles, but check the actual balance.

steps.text: Win three-round sets in @mechanic{Double or Nothing} and accept each double until the displayed balance exceeds @mechanic{$1,000,000}.

Write down the live-shell and blank counts. Update the counts after shots and Beer ejections. Avoid self-shots with unknown shells; use @item{Adrenaline} to take dangerous Dealer items such as Handcuffs or Hand Saw.
Choose @mechanic{X} at the next offer to bank the money. Dying or cashing out below the target means building a fresh streak.

achievements.description: Successfully shoot yourself with a blank, facing 50/50 odds.
achievements.summary: In single-player, fire a blank at yourself when live shells and blanks have equal odds.

steps.text: Play normal mode or @mechanic{Double or Nothing}. When the shotgun has one live shell and one blank remaining, aim at yourself and fire. A blank earns the achievement; if you draw the live shell, try again on another suitable load.

achievements.summary: Use Beer, a Cigarette Pack and Expired Medicine during one turn in Double or Nothing.

guide.context: Expired Medicine can cost one charge, so leave that item until last.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Double or Nothing}, save @item{Beer}, a @item{Cigarette Pack} and @item{Expired Medicine} until you can use the combination before firing.
Use the Cigarette Pack, drink the Beer, then take the Expired Medicine. If you fire before finishing the combination, gather the items and try again on another turn.

achievements.description: Lose more than 1000K in 'Double or Nothing'
achievements.summary: Die with more than $1,000,000 at stake in a Double or Nothing run.

guide.context: Money you cash out is already banked. After banking a million-dollar win, build a separate streak for this loss.

steps.text: Build a @mechanic{Double or Nothing} balance above @mechanic{$1,000,000}. Count the remaining live shells and blanks, and use Adrenaline to remove dangerous Dealer items while building the streak.
Accept another double, then fire live shells at yourself or let the @enemy{Dealer} kill you.

achievements.description: Try a forbidden name on the waiver.
achievements.summary: Submit GOD as your name on the liability waiver.

steps.text: When the @enemy{Dealer} presents the waiver, type @mechanic{GOD} and submit the name.

achievements.description: Use every single-player item type in one turn.
achievements.summary: Activate all nine distinct item types before firing during one turn in Double or Nothing.

guide.context: Nine types are required, but your table holds eight items. Adrenaline counts as one type and immediately uses a selected Dealer item as another. Item draws can make the setup take many attempts.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Double or Nothing}, save eight different item types, including @item{Adrenaline}. Wait for the Dealer to hold the ninth type. Use spare copies and empty shotgun loads to draw more items while building the setup.
Once the setup is ready, use the @item{Burner Phone} while at least two shells remain, before drinking Beer. If the phone is the missing type, use Adrenaline to take it from the Dealer first.

Before firing, use @item{Beer}, @item{Cigarette Pack}, @item{Hand Saw}, @item{Handcuffs}, @item{Inverter} and @item{Magnifying Glass}. Use Adrenaline for the missing type if needed; if that type is Expired Medicine, leave Adrenaline until the final step.

Finish with @item{Expired Medicine}, using Adrenaline if the medicine is on the Dealer’s side. Keep more than one charge before taking the medicine so a bad result cannot kill you before the combination finishes.
@warn{Do not fire until every item type has been used.} Even a blank aimed at yourself breaks the combination. If you fire early or lack a required type, build another setup and try again.

achievements.description: Fire a live shell at yourself after inspecting the chamber.
achievements.summary: In single-player, fire a live shell at yourself after inspecting that shell with a Magnifying Glass.

steps.text: In normal mode or @mechanic{Double or Nothing}, check the current shell with a @item{Magnifying Glass}. If the shell is live, shoot yourself without ejecting or inverting it.

achievements.description: Stay in the nightclub and listen to the music.
achievements.summary: Spend more than one minute listening to the music in the nightclub.

steps.text: Leave the bathroom and wait for over one minute in the @loc{nightclub corridor} with music and flashing lights, before entering the Dealer’s room.

achievements.description: Shoot yourself with the shortened shotgun.
achievements.summary: In single-player, hit yourself with a live shell after using a Hand Saw on the shotgun.

steps.text: In normal mode or @mechanic{Double or Nothing}, use a @item{Hand Saw}, then fire a live shell at yourself. To earn Why? with the same shot, first confirm the live shell with a @item{Magnifying Glass}.

achievements.summary: View the leaderboard on the bathroom TV.

steps.text: After winning normal mode, select the @loc{bathroom TV}, then choose the @mechanic{trophy icon} to open the leaderboard.
